text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — gpu-queue-surge in cluster-west. queue_length=642, pending_pods=174, scale_attempts=3
incident-bot: Autoscaler error: Failed to attach nodegroup: AttachRolePolicy rejected (iam:PassRole denied) and launchTemplate drift: user-data checksum mismatch
dave: ACK. paging @emma (oncall) and @ben infra. any quick wins?
emma: I'm on it. joining call in 2m. what's customer impact?
carla: Some critical eval jobs timing out. A few hosted infra customers seeing 503s on model-serving routes.
ben: Looking at autoscaler logs — see this:
```
[autoscaler] scaleup request -> launchTemplate: version mismatch (expected v9, got v7)
[ec2] runInstances -> UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole
```
ben: Seems IAM role used by autoscaler lost passrole permission after yesterday's infra policy rollout.
alice: We can manual-scale the GPU pool to unblock queue. If we add 6 g4dn nodes we should clear backlog. I'll cordon low-priority pods.
emma: Do it. Ben, can you confirm launch template version to use?
ben: Confirmed: lt-ml-gpu:v9 is the correct one. I'll force-set the nodegroup's LT to v9 and kick an instance refresh.
infra-bot: Started instance refresh for nodegroup gpu-pool-west (target version: v9). 6 new instances requested.
dave: Note: before refresh finishes, we should prevent autoscaler from repeating failed attach attempts. Emma, can you mute the autoscaler alerts and set scaling mode to manual?
emma: Muted alerts and switched autoscaler to manual mode. ping me when manual nodes are ready.
ben: First 3 instances up + kubelet registered. taint propagation failed on 1 — kubelet logs show "failed to apply taint: node not found" retrying.
alice: Cordoned and evicted low-priority jobs, prefetched KV caches for LLM infra. Queue length dropping: 642 -> 210.
carla: Notifying affected customers via status page. Temporary SLA impact for embeddings endpoint, ETA recovery ~25m.
dave: Good work. Postmortem action items: revert policy change, add CI check for LT checksum, ensure autoscaler has fallback to manual attach. I'll own the writeup.
emma: Handoff to night oncall @frank. I'll leave notes in the incident channel. handing off.
frank: Taking over. If anything regresses, ping me. :thumbsup:
